annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/545 of 26 January 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 ... type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their event data recorder
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/545 on type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their event data recorder
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 107/18
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting test procedures and technical requirements for type-approval of M1 passenger cars and separate units regarding event data recorders, incorporating UN Regulation 160, with added requirements on data protection from manipulation, anonymisation, retrieval, and roadworthiness checks.
key_provisions_or_claims: EDR systems must comply with UN Regulation No 160 plus additional EU requirements
Recorded data must be protected against manipulation per UN Regulation No 155 cybersecurity rules
Data must be retrievable via the standard connector in machine-readable form and not linked to a natural person
Periodic roadworthiness tests must verify EDR status and software integrity
Non-compliant new vehicles barred from registration from 6 July 2024; applies from 6 July 2022
